items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: Sudhalter even wanted me to go to England and do it... he called me up from England and wanted me to come over there, but he didn't want to pay enough.

ctx.x: Venuti. He had traveled all over Europe and he told me that he could get anything he wanted over there in the way of musicians and Sudhalter even wanted me to go to England and do it. 'You could get good musicians over there' and he did some concerts over there and called me up from England and wanted me to come over there, but he didn't want to pay enough. Didn't want to pay the expense.
I don't know how he made out, he must have made out all right. He went up to Williams, and got all the material out of Williams College. He copied it off and took it over there and gave concerts.
